headline: Palantir Q3 Revenue Surges 96% as Company Raises 2026 Guidance
summary: Palantir reported its third-quarter profit more than doubled as revenue jumped 96% to $2.31 billion, prompting the company to raise its full-year 2026 projections.
why: Palantir Technologies is a major software and artificial intelligence contractor serving defense and commercial markets, drawing intense investor scrutiny regarding enterprise AI adoption rates.

impacts.name: Palantir Technologies
impacts.why: Strong revenue growth and an upward revision of financial guidance directly boost the company's equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A near-doubling of quarterly revenue alongside increased forward guidance signaled accelerating business momentum, driving share appreciation.
